# maps/retro_showcase.gd

[Source:1](../../../../maps/retro_showcase.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Builds a moonlit gallery for the retro post-process, haze, materials and NPC rendering.
F6/F7/F8 are the shared Retro debug controls, not scene-specific effects.

Base: `Node3D`. Registered class: `none`.

### _brush

```gdscript
func _brush(center: Vector3, size: Vector3, texture: Texture2D, tile: float, surface := "stone") -> StaticBody3D
```

[Source:189](../../../../maps/retro_showcase.gd#L189)

A solid block with a texture laid on in world space, one tile every `tile`
metres, so blocks side by side continue each other's texture.

| `size` | `Vector3` | required |
